test_name: Verify User Login via Google OAuth
description: This test verifies that users can log in using their Google account via OAuth integration on the login page.
steps: Locate the Google OAuth login button using the stable selector.
Click on the Google OAuth login button.
Ensure the browser is redirected to the Google OAuth login page.
Enter valid Google account credentials and submit.
Verify that the user is redirected back to the application dashboard.
Check that the user's session is authenticated and a valid token is received.
Verify the presence of user-specific data on the dashboard (e.g., username or account details).
expected_results: The user is redirected to the Google OAuth login page.
The user is redirected back to the application dashboard after successful authentication.
The user's session is authenticated and a valid token is available.
User-specific data is displayed on the dashboard.
edge_cases: Canceling the Google login process midway.
Network issues during the OAuth redirection.
Token expiration before redirection to the app.
data_requirements: OAuth client ID and secret for Google integration.
Redirect URI configured in Google OAuth settings.
Session storage or cookies to store authentication tokens.
User profile data for verification on the dashboard.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be active and configured correctly.
The application must be registered with Google APIs.
The dashboard page must be accessible after login.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Google OAuth login page.
Time taken to redirect back to the application.
Response time of the user profile API.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google login button is keyboard navigable.
Verify proper ARIA roles for the login button.
Check for color contrast compliance on the login button.
